decision: Generate a Gluetun-only add-on for the already running Tuniku stack while retaining explicit opt-in for a secret-bearing response.
rationale: Generating Tuniku again can collide with the existing host port and prevent the add-on stack from being created. The existing redaction control remains an appropriate deliberate boundary for deployment-ready credentials.
security_boundary: Secret values are redacted by default and a full result is returned only after an authenticated administrator explicitly enables it for that generation.
A full result is removed from the browser after 15 minutes.
Saved drafts, logs, audits, diagnostics, and inspected Compose remain redacted.
Tuniku does not write the generated file, call Docker, or deploy the stack.
compatibility: The add-on joins the stable external Docker network name tuniku created by the primary stack.
The server-side includeSecrets=false mode remains the default and is always used for saved drafts.
HTTPS_ONLY=false keeps trusted-LAN HTTP available; true enables Secure session cookies for reverse-proxy HTTPS.
rollback: Use the retained server-side redacted generation mode and merge Gluetun into the primary Compose manually.
